_provenance.author: Written by the project author for this benchmark. NOT an external or standard benchmark.
_provenance.purpose: Measure whether the LLM tool router selects the correct tool for a prompt.
_provenance.labelling_rule: expected = the single tool a correct router should call. 'none' means the prompt is answerable from conversation/context alone and no tool should fire.
known_limitations: Small sample (40 prompts), author-written, English only.
Prompts are unambiguous by construction; real user phrasing is messier, so accuracy here is an upper bound.
Class balance is deliberate, not representative of real traffic mix.
'none' is the hardest class in practice because the router is biased toward acting.
